newsitem.title: UK: Hemp-flavoured drink hits UK stores, but not minds.
newsitem.headline: Hemp-flavoured drink hits UK stores, but not minds.

text.p: Britons with that dry taste in their mouths can now reach for a new thirst quencher -- hemp-flavoured soda.
But those seeking the effects of marijuana, hemp's illicit derivative, should not get their hopes too high.
The citrus soda is called Hemp, but all psychoactive substances have been weeded out, according to Shackleford Sales Ltd, which imports the German-owned brand.

"We are targeting consumers who are looking for a premium energy soft drink," a spokeswoman said on Wednesday, adding that Britain's Home Office has confirmed that the drink has no illegal substances.
The soda contains caffeine and vitamins as well as hemp oil, which lays on a nutty flavour, the company said.
The product, being peddled since May at posh department store Selfridges, was previously rolled out in Germany by Designer Food International.
